unavailable: The export model is not configured on the server.
unauthorized: A service Bearer token is required.
busy: All processing slots are busy. Try again later.
invalid_json: Expected one JSON object with analysis and news fields; the total request limit is 1 MiB.
invalid_input: Supply completed analysis.json and its original news.json with unique IDs, control time, and a 24-hour period.
invalid_control_time: A valid ISO 8601 control time with a time zone is required.
invalid_period_start: The period must start exactly 24 hours before the control time.
dataset_required: news.json must include a dataset name.
items_required: news.json must include an items array; an empty array is allowed.
invalid_article_ids: Every article must have a unique nonempty ID.
export_metadata_mismatch: Analysis and news metadata do not match. Use analysis.json and news.json from the same dataset and period.
invalid_selection: recommended_order must contain at most five unique IDs of existing groups; an empty array is allowed.
invalid_analysis: analysis.json must contain groups and excluded objects.
analysis_input_too_large: The dataset is too large for one request. Reduce the text volume.
generation_failed: Could not create the files. Check the saved audit, API key permissions, and export model availability.
invalid_model_output: The model response does not match the export structure. The original response is saved in the audit; no completed files were produced.
content_filter: Yandex stopped generation with content_filter. The partial response is retained only in the audit; no completed files were produced.
max_output_tokens: The response exceeded YANDEX_EXPORT_MAX_OUTPUT_TOKENS. Increase it within the supported limit or reduce the input; the partial response is retained only in the audit.
refusal: The model refused to process the supplied material. The response is saved in the audit; no completed files were produced.
storage_error: Could not persist the run. The result is not reported as saved.
